name: v9_no_conditions
judgment_target: Correct execution of the single action AND useful progress toward the task.
ablation: Remove explicit precondition/postcondition generation and the associated condition-check sections; retain evidence-grounded rationale and final verdict.

input_contract.dynamic_geometry: Use the same geometry block and coordinate normalization as v9_geometry, injected before === Context ===.

online_feedback_note: For a condition-generation-only online ablation, apply the same reason extraction, truncation, and No-only injection policy to both arms. The existing v9 formatter specially extracts Postcondition check and Task progress from a structured reason, so routing a plain rationale through its fallback does not by itself establish identical feedback processing.
scope_note: With a fixed checkpoint this is an inference-prompt ablation. A training ablation additionally requires comparable two-field targets and training.
